question: Vilayat Khan is associated with which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sitar.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ustad Vilayat Khan **(28 August 1928 – 13 March 2004)** was an Indian classical sitar player.
 
• Along with Imdad Khan, Enayat Khan, and Imrat Khan, he is credited with the creation and development of gayaki ang (an attempt to mimic the sound of the human voice) on the sitar.
 
• Ustad Enayat Khan **(1894–1938)** also known as Nath Singh was one of India's most influential sitar and surbahar players in the first decades of the 20th century. He was the father of Vilayat Khan, one of the topmost sitariyas (sitar players) of the postwar period.
 
• Vilayat Khan died on **13 March 2004 in Mumbai, India at age 75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Hindu God Lord Krishna** is traditionally considered a master of the bamboo flute.
 
• **Pandit Shankar Ghosh** (10 October 1935 – 22 January 2016). A tabla maestro from the Farukhabad Gharana of Hindustani Classical music, Pandit Shankar Ghosh is noted as one of the greatest artists of all time.
 
• Distinguished players of the tabla include Alla Rakha Khan and his son Zakir Hussain.
 
• James Galway is considered by many seasoned and newbie flute players as one of the greatest flute players and the most famous in the world.
 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia (1st July 1938) is known internationally as the greatest living master of the bansuri, the North Indian bamboo flute.**
